stemMd: How many distinct real solutions does x to the fourth minus 5x squared plus 4=0 have?
explanationMd: Set u=x squared. Then u squared−5u+4=(u−1)(u−4), so x squared is 1 or 4. This gives x=±1,±2, four distinct real solutions.

distractorRationale.c: This counts values of x squared rather than both signs of x.
distractorRationale.d: The solutions occur in opposite-sign pairs with no zero root.
distractorRationale.b: There are two positive squared values.
